name: DCT spectral expand upscale
plain: Upscale in the cosine domain: embed the DCT coefficients in a larger zero grid, fill the new high band with sigma-scaled noise through a taper, and inverse transform. It also rescales the signal and returns an aligned sigma, so sampling can continue at matched noise. Three blend modes; hard and linear are identical in the code.
math:
F=DCT(x); Fe=zero grid with Fe[:H,:W]=F; mask=1 low, cosine taper near old edge
linear: mask·Fe+(1−mask)·σ·s·ε
variance_preserving: mask·Fe+√(1−mask²)·σ·s·ε
t=σ/(1+σ) if edm; t′=rt/(1+(r−1)t); κ=r/(1+(r−1)t); x′=κ·IDCT
lowpass start: x_low=IDCT(F[:th,:tw])

props.params: scale_factor, sigma, noise_strength, seed, taper, blend_mode, edm_style
